sn35.25:1.1: sabbaṃ abhiññāpariññā pahānāya vo bhikkhave dhammaṃ desissāmi
sn35.25:1.3: katamo ca bhikkhave sabbaṃ abhiññāpariññā pahānāya dhammo.
sn35.25:1.4: cakkhuṃ bhikkhave abhiññāpariññā pahātabbaṃ rūpā abhiññāpariññā pahātabbā cakkhuviññāṇaṃ abhiññāpariññā pahātabbaṃ cakkhusamphasso abhiññāpariññā pahātabbo yampidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi abhiññāpariññā pahātabbaṃ …pe…
sn35.25:1.6: jivhā abhiññāpariññā pahātabbā rasā abhiññāpariññā pahātabbā jivhāviññāṇaṃ abhiññāpariññā pahātabbaṃ jivhāsamphasso abhiññāpariññā pahātabbo yampidaṃ jivhāsamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi abhiññāpariññā pahātabbaṃ.
sn35.25:1.8: mano abhiññāpariññā pahātabbo dhammā abhiññāpariññā pahātabbā manoviññāṇaṃ abhiññāpariññā pahātabbaṃ manosamphasso abhiññāpariññā pahātabbo yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi abhiññāpariññā pahātabbaṃ.
sn35.25:1.9: ayaṃ kho bhikkhave sabbaṃ abhiññāpariññā pahānāya dhammoti.
